title: Better With Features
description: BTA mod to fix technical user-friendliness gaps in features between Beta and modern Minecraft
body:
This mod tries to fix gaps in features between BTA and modern Minecraft, which are mostly technical user-friendliness. All of client features are configurable.
## This includes features such as:
- Double space key flying
- F3+F4 to switch gamemodes
- F3+C to copy coords into clipboard
- Holding F3+C to exit the game faster (maybe?)
- Mobs no longer track creative/spectator players
- Arrow keys to immediately go through command suggestions instead of going through message history
